summary.text: Rebecca Keltie is a Republican who represents District 16 (El Paso County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where she took office on January 8, 2025; Ballotpedia lists her as not running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Keltie was born in Flint, Michigan, served in the U.S. Navy from 1988 to 2014, and earned a military citation from the Community College of the Air Force.
Her career experience includes work as an engineer and in information technology, project management, meteorology and oceanography, and as a small business owner, Ballotpedia says.
